messages:
sam: FYI I'm going to enable the feature flag `capacity_relax_v2` for canary group `migration-2026` at 15:30 UTC today to let the NLU backfill finish. Need oncall eyes and any objections. :eyes:
anya: Quick q — what's the exact scope (audience %, regions) and the temporary guardrails? Also will this require an SLO exception?
mike: +1 on details. If burst tokens are high we should ensure a short circuit breaker. Last time we saw cascade when queueing timeout + high concurrency hit together.
sam: Good calls. Config I'll flip: 10% of production traffic (US-east + EU-west), burst_tokens=400, queue_timeout_ms=2500, max_concurrency_soft_cap=110. No SLO change expected but planning a 2hr SLO exception window starting at the flip time just in case.
sam: Flag JSON I'm going to apply (small diff):
```json
{
  "flag": "capacity_relax_v2",
  "audience": "migration-2026",
  "pct": 10,
  "regions": ["us-east-1","eu-west-1"],
  "overrides": {
    "burst_tokens": 400,
    "queue_timeout_ms": 2500,
    "max_concurrency_soft_cap": 110
  },
  "circuit_breaker": {
    "requests_per_minute": 12000,
    "error_rate_pct": 5
  }
}
```
anya: Thanks. Can we add a hard fallback policy to a lower-capacity variant (model-small) if queue depth > 300 or 5xx rate > 3%?
sam: Yes — will add fallback to `model-alpha-small` and a forced throttle path. Adding conditions: queue_depth_threshold=300, fallback_5xx_pct=3.
mike: Also recommend an alert: `burst_queueing_spike` when avg_queue_ms > 1500 for 3m or token consumption > 80% of pool for 5m. We should tie that to an automated rollback action in runbook.
liz: I'll update the runbook with the explicit kill-switch steps + escalation matrix. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/capacity-relax-rollout (adding notes for oncall).
oncall-bot: FYI — alert policy `burst_queueing_spike` currently exists but has auto-mute. Recommend unmuting for the 2hr window: run `./ops/alerts unmute burst_queueing_spike --until 1955559334`.
devops-bot: CI check: rollout plan passes smoke checks. Canary health probe will run every 30s for 20m after flip.
anya: One more ask — please document the rollback command here so oncall can execute quickly.
sam: Rollback command pinned below. I'll post the flag at 15:30 UTC and monitor for 40m. If any of these fire: avg_queue_ms>1500 (3m), 5xx>3% (5m), or token pool >80% (5m) — we rollback immediately.
```
# rollback
curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/capacity_relax_v2/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"audience":"migration-2026"}'
```
mike: Got it. I'll monitor dashboards + set a short-lived pager for this window.
liz: Runbook updated and added the exact Pager escalation path.
sam: Thanks all — flipping at 15:30 UTC. Will post a status update in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
mike: LGTM
anya: 👍
